entries.enrichment: Tier A — scroll-linked CSS 3D scene cuts (framer-motion useScroll/useTransform) + typographic product diagrams
entries.brief: Redesign step 1 of 3 of the client-intake flow for enterprise IT leads: sticky chapter pane + 3D scenes (profile, counted figures, 5 real products, stack, commitments) → primary 'see the process', secondary 'send a request'.
entries.motionRationale: Scroll-linked on purpose: user asked for film-like 3D scene cuts; Feature Stack is built on scroll position. Reduced motion = 140ms opacity only; <48rem wide or <42rem tall = flat stack.

contract.enrichment: real 3D capture, CSS pointer tilt and a 2.5D shaded robot that enters and leaves through a hatch cut into the header rail

iteration.brief: The mascot read as a flat sprite that vanished for no reason, and the page under-sold the platform's real breadth. Rebuild the mascot as a 2.5D scene with a narrative exit through a hatch in the rail; surface every real landing statistic instead of three; restore the Ecosystem Index numbering on the directory rails.
variationKnobs: three-plane shaded shell with one global light direction
two-segment limbs (elbow and knee) instead of single-bone limbs
hatch in the rail as the mascot's entrance and exit
six real statistics plus a counted-at provenance line
